_comment: The ritual registry: which steps /project-memory runs, in which phase, in order.
LAW 1 (anti-rot): every generator in this system is listed here and runs ONLY through
the ritual. A generator not registered here will silently rot - that is not a theory,
it is what happened to the source system's history timeline for 2.5 months.
System steps are NAMES bound to argv in checkctl.py (CHECKS for check, GENERATORS for
polish, PUBLISH_STEPS for publish) - this file never carries a shell string for them.
Project steps DO carry an argv LIST (never a string,
never shell=True): a project must be able to run its own tests. This file lives in the
protected config tree, so adding one is a main-session, user-gated edit.

project_steps._comment: Project-registered steps. kind: check|polish|generator. argv is a LIST, run without a shell. Example: {"name": "pytest", "kind": "check", "argv": ["uv", "run", "pytest", "-q"], "required": true}

data_series._comment: Project counters plotted on the STORY tab's data-evolution lane. Each entry: {"name": "...", "kind": "file_count"|"jsonl_lines", "path": "relative/path"}.

snapshot._comment: Vault snapshots at PUBLISH. Off by default; the vault lives in RECORD_ROOT, never in the repo.
